items.title: Jack Daniel's owner rejected a $15B buyout. Sazerac isn't backing down
items.summary: A rejected buyout bid hasn't stopped Sazerac from pursuing Brown-Forman. The company says it's open to improving its offer and wants talks to continue.

items.title: Brown-Forman rejects Sazerac takeover bid
items.summary: The Jack Daniel's owner said the proposal wasn’t “actionable” months after declining a separate offer from Pernod Ricard.

items.title: Brown-Forman board dismisses unsolicited takeover proposal from Sazerac
items.summary: Brown-Forman (NYSE:BF. A), the producer of Jack Daniel’s whiskey, said its board has reviewed an unsolicited takeover approach from privately owned spirits group Sazerac and determined that the proposal was “not actionable.

items.title: Sazerac Wants Another Shot at Jack Daniel’s Maker Brown-Forman
